response.justification: Bogdan is a strong, versatile senior/staff individual contributor with 15+ years of hands-on engineering across web, backend, and low-latency distributed systems (notably microservices handling high request volumes at Sociomantic/Dunnhumby), plus early exposure to AI-agent tooling via MCP code generators at re:cinq. However, the role is an executive CTO position with hard requirements he does not meet: no evidence of senior technical leadership at scale, no track record of scaling engineering teams from 10 to 30+ or building a leadership layer, no board-level communication experience, and no production multi-agent AI systems in regulated or high-stakes environments. Fintech exposure is limited to one product engineering role at RIDE Capital, without credit-risk, working-capital, or compliance-infrastructure ownership. The gap between staff IC and CTO of a venture-backed scale-up is too wide for this specific mandate.
strengths: 15+ years hands-on engineering breadth, including low-latency microservices at massive request scale
Early hands-on exposure to agentic AI infrastructure (MCP code generators, agent frameworks)
Founder of an open-source event-driven platform; strong testing/craftsmanship and Kubernetes/DevOps grounding
concerns: No executive or people-leadership experience; no evidence of scaling teams to 30+ or hiring leaders
No production multi-agent AI systems, LLM evaluation, or real-time inference architecture experience
Thin fintech-infrastructure depth — no credit risk, liquidity, or multi-jurisdiction compliance ownership

key_factors.factor: No production agentic AI systems experience
Distributed systems and low-latency backend depth
